title: Ship Agent Configuration
description: Schema for .ship/agents/<id>.jsonc — an agent definition that controls identity, skills, MCP servers, plugins, permissions, hooks, rules, and harness settings.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocompletion.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Currently '1'. Used for forward-compatible migrations.

id.description: Machine identifier. Must match the filename stem (e.g. rust-compiler.jsonc has id rust-compiler).

description.description: What this agent does — shown in `ship agents` and editor UI.

tags.description: Searchable tags for registry discovery (e.g. workflow, review, testing, frontend).

icon.description: Display icon — emoji or icon name (e.g. '🧪', 'test-tube').

role.description: DEPRECATED (Floki D2b): superseded by top-level `capabilities`. The gate enforces capability, not role. Legacy mapping (worker → 'worker'; lead/commander → 'orchestrator') is still honored by the local stdio gate until removed.

tools_preset.description: DEPRECATED (Floki D2b): superseded by top-level `capabilities`. See `role`.

active_tools.description: DEPRECATED (Floki D2b): superseded by top-level `capabilities`. See `role`.

capabilities.description: Ship-op authority grants — gate-enforced. Each entry grants the agent ops in `domain` up to the `blast` ceiling. Replaces the deprecated `role`/`tools_preset` derivation. C0 (read) and C1 (workspace-write) are an implicit baseline every agent already has; C3 (critical) is operator-only and NEVER agent-settable (omit it). Mirrors ship_ops_rpc::BlastRadius.

domain.description: Ship-op service domain this grant covers (e.g. 'collections', 'runtime', 'mcp').

blast.description: Blast-radius ceiling for ops in `domain`. C0: read (anyone). C1: workspace-write (any agent). C2: elevated (granted agents). C3 (critical) is operator-only and rejected here. The proto descriptor aliases (C0_SAFE, C1_WORKSPACE, C2_ELEVATED) are also accepted by the parser.

refs.description: Skill IDs to activate. Supports local IDs (e.g. tdd) and namespaced IDs (e.g. github.com/owner/repo/skill-name).

mcp.description: MCP server activation for this agent.

servers.description: MCP server IDs to activate from .ship/mcp.jsonc.

plugins.description: Plugin installation intent. The compiler emits a manifest; the CLI executes the installs.

install.description: Plugin IDs to install, e.g. superpowers@claude-plugins-official.

scope.description: Installation scope. project installs locally, user installs globally.

permissions.description: Permission overrides. Merged on top of the named preset from permissions.jsonc.

preset.description: Named permission preset — must match a key in .ship/permissions.jsonc. Defines the base permission tier.

tools_allow.description: Tool patterns to allow. Merged on top of the preset's allow list.

tools_deny.description: Tool patterns to deny. Merged on top of the preset's deny list.

tools_ask.description: Tool patterns requiring user confirmation. Merged on top of the preset's ask list.

default_mode.description: Default permission mode. plan: read-only. default: ask for writes. acceptEdits: auto-approve file edits. dontAsk: fully autonomous. bypassPermissions: no restrictions.

rules.description: Inline rules appended to the context file after .ship/rules/*.md files.

inline.description: Inline always-on rules. Use \n for line breaks.

refs.description: Rule IDs to filter the project rule pool to (file names without the `NNNN-` prefix / `.md` suffix). Empty = inherit the whole pool.

hooks.description: Hook commands declared on the agent. The general HookConfig form (carrying a HookTrigger); compile emits each into the active harness's hook registration (e.g. .claude/settings.json:hooks).

id.description: Stable identifier for this hook entry (used as a key when merging into harness config).

trigger.description: Lifecycle event that fires this hook. Stop fires on agent session end; SubagentStop on sub-agent end; PreToolUse/PostToolUse gate tool calls; Notification fires on agent notifications; PreCompact fires before context compaction.

matcher.description: Optional tool-name matcher (e.g. "Bash", "Edit"). When set, the hook only fires for matching tool calls. Ignored for non-PreToolUse/PostToolUse triggers.

command.description: Shell command to run when the hook fires.

cursor_event.description: Raw Cursor event name. When set, bypasses trigger mapping and emits directly to Cursor's hooks file.

target_agents.description: Harness targets to sync this agent to (e.g. ["claude", "codex"]). Empty = sync to every blessed harness.

apps.description: Ship app integrations for this agent.

studio.description: When true, the compiler emits an HTTP MCP transport pointing at Studio's local endpoint instead of a stdio `ship mcp serve` entry.

isolation.description: Where this agent runs. File-authored; resolved at platform runtime by the isolation recommender (narrowest wins: agent < per-run < user defaults). Absent = inherit the next level.

tier.description: Preferred isolation tier (strength order). none: host process, no sandbox. process: per-process FS + syscall sandbox. container: OCI container. vm: microVM or full VM. cloud: vendor-served sandbox.

strategy.description: Optional pin of a concrete strategy within the tier. noop: no sandbox. harness_native: harness sandboxes itself. srt: @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime wrapper. harness: legacy per-harness best-fit. docker/youki/wsl2: container. lima/apple_container/firecracker: vm. fly: cloud.

policy.description: Optional policy override (mounts, network, env, limits).

label.description: Human-readable label for the resolved sandbox.

mounts.description: Extra filesystem mounts exposed inside the sandbox.

network.description: Network policy — a named preset string or an inline policy object.

env.description: Environment variables injected into the sandbox.

limits.description: Resource limits (memory, CPU, process count) for the sandbox.

harness_settings.description: Per-agent harness-specific overrides. Merged on top of project-level harness_defaults from ship.jsonc (agent wins on conflict, deep merge). Keys are harness names. Values validated against upstream harness schemas, with Ship-managed keys excluded (use Ship's own fields for permissions, env, hooks, etc.). Set the model here, under the relevant harness key.

claude.description: Claude Code settings pass-through. Ship-managed keys (permissions, hooks, env, availableModels, maxCostPerSession, maxTurns, autoMemoryEnabled) must be set via Ship's own fields. Set `model` here.

codex.description: Codex CLI config pass-through. Ship-managed keys (mcp_servers) must be set via Ship's own fields. Set `model` here.

opencode.description: OpenCode config pass-through. Ship-managed keys (mcp, permission) must be set via Ship's own fields. Set `model` here.

pi.description: Pi settings. No upstream schema published — open pass-through.

omp.description: omp settings (pi fork). No upstream schema published — open pass-through.

ToolPattern.description: A tool permission pattern. Syntax: bare tool name (Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep), parameterized tool (Bash(git *), Bash(rm -rf *)), MCP tool (mcp__<server>__<tool>, e.g. mcp__github__create_issue), or glob (mcp__*__delete*, Bash(*)).
